# eslee-Auto-Power v1.0.8

- New schedules open five minutes ahead at minute precision, including natural midnight rollover. Existing +1/+2-hour actions are preserved.
- Tray quick shutdown and the editor share the later-wake consequence notice; one save remains one schedule even if UI refresh fails.
- Korean/English safe tests: 160 passed per language during audit verification. Windows PR CI keeps these checks mandatory.
- Native shutdown flags, recovery and scheduling were tested with fakes. No host shutdown/sleep/hibernate was performed. Actual S3/S4/S5 and firmware wake behavior remains unverified: this Windows 11 Home host has no available disposable Windows VM/Sandbox.

Release assets include SHA-256 checksums and a manifest recording the exact source commit and successful release checks. A tag/source-version mismatch, missing asset or failed check stops publication. Existing releases are never overwritten.
